A LITTLE CLARITY

Good questions.
Useful answers.

Do you guarantee same-day or next-day delivery?+

No universal same-day or next-day guarantee is published here. Ask the team to confirm what is available for your exact shipment and route.

Can I request urgent pickup?+

You can share your preferred pickup time with the team. Availability and any booking cutoff need to be confirmed.

How do I choose express versus economy?+

Tell the team your delivery priority and budget. They can discuss available options and shipment-specific estimates.
